shorts.title: What you will learn: Functions
shorts.hook: Write the code once. Use it a hundred times.
shorts.script: Write the code once. Use it a hundred times. Today we stop repeating ourselves. A function is a named block of code that you can call whenever you want. A function is a named block of code. You write it once, and you call it by name as often as you like. When the function ends, the program returns to the line after the call. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Functions.

shorts.title: Functions in one minute
shorts.hook: A function is a named block of code.
shorts.script: A function is a named block of code. You write it once, and you call it by name as often as you like. When the function ends, the program returns to the line after the call. A function that gives nothing back has the type void. Think of a tea stall. There is one recipe, and it makes many cups. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Functions in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.script: This line is a declaration. It tells the compiler that tea exists, and it ends with a semicolon. Now main can call tea, even though the body comes later. The full definition sits below main. Without the declaration, the compiler would not know the name tea at line seven. The program prints One cup of tea. A function is a named block of code. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Calling a function before it exists
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. Main calls tea, but the function is written below main. The compiler says tea was not declared in this scope. It reads from top to bottom. Add a declaration above main, or move the whole function above main. The compiler reads the file from top to bottom. It must see a function name before the line that uses it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: I wrote a function to make tea. It returns void, and my cup is empty.
shorts.script: I wrote a function to make tea. It returns void, and my cup is empty. Write a function called banner. It prints a line of stars. Call it before and after a message. Write your answer in the comments. A function is a named block of code. You call it by writing its name and brackets. Void means the function gives nothing back. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
